summary: Iteration 153 — Full-stack verification of the new EU CRA AI Analyst per-tab, per-item CraExplain cards, and the 3 new connector categories (Universal API / QMS / LIMS), plus regression on the 6 prior features. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter153_cra_ai_and_connectors.py = 16/16 PASS: (a) POST /api/cra/dashboard-insight for ALL 10 non-mission tabs (products, certification, ledger, sbom, vulnerability, conformity, declaration, regulation, controls, nist) returns {headline, insights[3-6], actions[>=1], tab, model, generated_at}; no leaked SAP/SoD/cyber-crisis strings; (b) POST /api/cra/explain returns {summary, severity in risk|watch|opportunity|info, risk, risk_detail, recommendation, steps[>=2]}; (c) GET /api/cra/nist returns overall {alignment_percentage:82, functions_total:6, functions_aligned:1} plus all 6 CSF functions GV/ID/PR/DE/RS/RC; (d) POST /api/cra/scorecard-link → 200 with token, GET /api/cra-public/scorecard/{token} → 200 with overall, GET /api/cra-public/scorecard/{token}/pdf → application/pdf %PDF header, POST /api/cra/scorecard-link/revoke → 200 and subsequent public GET → 401; (e) PUT /api/cra/controls/{rid}/assignment persists owner correctly; (f) GET /api/connectors/catalog exposes all new IDs — Universal API (universal-rest, universal-apikey, universal-webhook), Quality Management (QMS) (greenlight-guru, mastercontrol, qualio, etq-reliance, veeva-vault-qms, sparta-trackwise), Labs & Testing (LIMS) (labware-lims, labvantage, starlims, benchling, thermo-samplemanager, ul-solutions, intertek, tuv-sud, eurofins); GET /api/connectors/health lists 58 connectors and does not fabricate 'connected' for the credentialled QMS/LIMS entries. Frontend Playwright (admin jblan2026@gmail.com, Chromium 1920x1080): logged in via Enter key + dismissed onboarding tour. On /app/cra-governance, cra-tab-analyst-<tab> renders on ALL 10 non-mission tabs (products, certification, ledger, sbom, vulnerability, conformity, declaration, regulation, controls, nist) with a non-empty cra-tab-analyst-headline-<tab> (140–230 chars, e.g. controls: 'EU CRA controls posture is 82% overall across 18 requirements, but only 3 of 8 products are assessed…') and cra-tab-analyst-refresh-<tab> present. Control Dashboard: 18 cra-control-row-<REQID> rows; clicking one opens cra-control-drill and a cra-explain card with real AI content — cra-explain-summary ("Scope determination for products with digital elements is only partially imple…"), cra-explain-risk ('MEDIUM RISK'), cra-explain-risk-detail ('Incomplete scope determination can leave in-scope products outside CRA compliance…'), cra-explain-recommendation ('Complete and document scope determination for all products with digital elements…'). Gap-owner assignment form (cra-assign-owner/due/status/note/save) all present; save clicked → 200. cra-scorecard-generate produced /cra-scorecard/<token> URL with expiry line; cra-scorecard-revoke worked. Public /cra-scorecard/<token> (no auth) loaded (cra-scorecard-page) showing cra-scorecard-overall='82%', 'Download PDF' button (cra-scorecard-download), 'expires 9/12/2026' line, and 0 leaked product names (Aegis Identity Broker/Test Firewall/Acme VPN Gateway/TrustAnchor HSM/Notekeeper Cloud all absent). NIST tab: cra-nist-overall='82%' + all six cra-nist-fn-GV/ID/PR/DE/RS/RC cards render (88/75/88/100/75/Unknown %). Per-item AI toggle (cra-explain-toggle) counts: 8 on Products, 1 on Vulnerability (org has 1 CVE row), 6 on NIST (one per function), 0 on Conformity (org has 0 external-assessment requests today — data-conditional, not a bug). On /app/systems (Connector Health), all 3 new categories render (Universal API, Quality Management (QMS), Labs & Testing (LIMS)) and every one of the 18 new connectors is visible (Universal REST API, Universal API Key, Universal Webhook, Greenlight Guru, MasterControl, Qualio, ETQ Reliance, Veeva Vault QMS, TrackWise, LabWare LIMS, LabVantage LIMS, STARLIMS, Benchling, SampleManager, UL Solutions, Intertek, TUV SUD, Eurofins).

issues: Tab bar overflows horizontally on 1920 width and hides 'Mission Control' behind the collapse rail on smaller viewports — cosmetic, no interaction impact (all cra-tab-<id> testids remain clickable).

Global banner says '58/58 connectors connected and ingesting' while GET /connectors/health returns 1 connected + 57 credentials_required — the aggregate label is misleading versus the honest per-card 'Requires credentials' states rendered below.

action_items: Optional: reconcile the '58/58 connectors connected and ingesting' summary tile on Connector Health with the honest per-connector state (only 1 is actually connected).

Optional: emergent gpt-5.4 explain-cache first hit inside a drill dialog can take ~10-25s cold — consider rendering the fallback earlier or streaming partial text so cra-explain-summary appears within a couple seconds even before the model returns.
critical_code_review_comments: cra_governance.py has grown to 1814 lines (up from 1403 in iter152). Split into cra_ai.py (dashboard-insight + explain + _cra_tab_context + fallbacks), cra_digest.py, cra_portal.py to keep each module <700 LOC.

CraExplain calls POST /cra/explain on every mount — inside a modal drill this is fine, but the 8 Product toggle cards on the Products tab each fire an /explain request when opened; consider a single client-side cache keyed on (kind,title,context-hash) to avoid duplicate requests when a user re-opens the same card.

dashboard-insight uses a 16s per-tab llm timeout with a fallback; that's good, but the client shows no distinct loading state vs fallback state — an authenticated data-testid attribute like data-source='live'|'fallback' would help E2E tests detect degraded output.
Public scorecard payload includes ISO 'expires_at' and the UI now renders 'expires 9/12/2026' — verified. Consider also surfacing 'expires in N days' to match the 'N days to next CRA deadline' chip.
connectors_catalog.py Universal API/QMS/LIMS entries share nearly-identical probe blocks — extract a helper _bearer_probe(base, token) to remove ~40 lines of duplication.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 10 tab analyst panels, control drill CraExplain, product/vuln/nist toggles, assignment save, scorecard mint/revoke, public scorecard load, 3 new connector categories with all 18 items)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing org data (8 CRA products, 18 requirements, 82% posture). Revoked all scorecard tokens before UI mint so the cap wouldn't collide. Assignment test used TEST_owner@example.com placeholder written to the first control requirement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab ids in /app/frontend/src/pages/CRAGovernance.jsx are ['mission','products','certification','ledger','sbom','vulnerability','conformity','declaration','regulation','controls','nist']. The review request called them 'portal' and 'labs' but the real testids are 'certification' and 'conformity' — use those. cra-explain-toggle count on the Conformity tab is data-conditional (0 if the org has no external-assessment requests); create a POST /api/cra/external-assessments to force one for a full toggle-count test. gpt-5.4 explain calls can take 10-25s on cold cache — always wait for cra-explain-summary (not just cra-explain) to confirm real content. Public scorecard token 429 cap is 5/org; run POST /api/cra/scorecard-link/revoke first if minting fails.
rca of the issue: No functional issues. Two initial test-only mismatches in my first pytest run: (a) asserted b['overall']['percentage'] on /cra/nist but the field is 'alignment_percentage' — corrected. (b) asserted revoked public token returns 403/404/410 but backend returns 401 — corrected. (c) connectors/health returns {connectors:[...]} not a bare list — corrected. All three were assertion bugs in my test file only; no code changes required.
